description: This file contains utility functions for directory and file operations such as recursive copy, recursive mkdir, recursive remove, file finding based on MIME type or extension, and file modification checks. Additionally, it includes security entry point validation.

methods.name: copy_recursive
methods.description: Recursively copies files and directories from source to destination and clears cache for PHP files.

methods.name: mkdir_recursive
methods.description: Creates directories recursively, handling absolute and relative paths, including Windows-specific paths.

methods.name: findTextFiles
methods.description: Scans a directory tree to find text/html and text/plain files based on MIME type.

methods.name: getBacktraceString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the current call stack for debugging.

methods.name: findAllFiles
methods.description: Recursively finds all files in a directory, optionally filtering by extension and excluding certain directories.

methods.name: findAllFilesRelative
methods.description: Finds all files relative to a directory path.

methods.name: findAllTouchedFiles
methods.description: Finds files modified after a given date, optionally filtered by a regex.
